wrappedKey.description: A symmetric key encrypted (wrapped) to a specific DID's public key. The recipient can decrypt this with their private key to recover the underlying symmetric key.

did.description: The DID whose public key was used to wrap this key.

ciphertext.description: The symmetric key, encrypted to the DID's public key. Base64-encoded in JSON. The hybrid wrap envelope is 32 + 1088 + 40 = 1160 bytes; the legacy x25519-only envelope (pair flow) is 32 + 40 = 72 bytes.

algo.description: Asymmetric algorithm used for key wrapping. Default is the hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 KEM (BSI TR-02102 / ANSSI guidance). The x25519-only variant is retained for the device-pairing flow until that flow is hybridized.

keyringMember.description: A keyring member: a wrapped group key paired with the member's workspace role. Role is plaintext because the indexer needs it for authorization decisions.

wrappedKey.description: The group key wrapped to this member's public key.

role.description: The member's role in the workspace.

encryptionEnvelope.description: Describes how a blob's content was encrypted. Contains the algorithm, nonce/IV, and one or more wrapped copies of the content encryption key.

algo.description: Symmetric encryption algorithm used on the blob content.

nonce.description: The nonce / initialization vector used for encryption.

keys.description: One or more wrapped copies of the content encryption key, each encrypted to a different DID.

keyringRef.description: Instead of per-document key wrapping, references a keyring whose group key was used to encrypt the content key. The content key is stored encrypted under the group key.

keyring.description: AT URI of the app.opake.keyring record.

wrappedContentKey.description: The content encryption key, encrypted with the keyring's group symmetric key (using the same algo as the content encryption).

rotation.description: The keyring rotation counter at the time this content key was wrapped. Clients use this to identify which generation of the group key to use for decryption.

encryptedMetadata.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted metadata payload. The ciphertext contains a JSON object with the real record metadata. Encrypted with the symmetric key that protects the parent record (content key for documents/grants, group key for keyrings).

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the JSON-serialized metadata object.

directKeyWrapping.description: Content key wrapped directly to individual DIDs. Used by records without blobs (directories, grants) where only the key material is needed — no cipher algorithm or nonce.

keys.description: One or more wrapped copies of the content key, each encrypted to a different DID.

keyringKeyWrapping.description: Content key wrapped under a keyring's group key. Used by records without blobs (directories) where only the keyring reference is needed — no cipher algorithm or nonce.

keyringRef.description: Reference to the keyring whose group key protects the content key.

visibility.description: Hint for indexers and clients about intended visibility of the content.
